past.title: It began with a question
past.body: I joined Amity University Noida for a Bachelor of Computer Application and chose **Data Science** as my interest. I wanted to know how a pile of numbers becomes a clear answer.

learn.title: Then the tools
learn.body: SQL first: T-SQL, CTEs, window functions. Then Python and Pandas, Excel and Power BI. Self-driven projects followed, and each one taught me something the classroom did not.

present.title: What I build today
present.body: Pipelines, dashboards and AI apps. Keep scrolling and the work flies past, one project at a time.

future.title: Where I’m headed
future.body: Data Scientist & Analyst, BI and AI Developer roles, and internships. I want to build the systems that let a team ask a question and trust the answer: models, cleaner pipelines, sharper dashboards, and AI agents that do real work.

home.quote: “Without data, you’re just another person with an opinion.”
